title: DevSecOps Topology Snapshot Reference
description: Typed reference to a GAIA topology snapshot. Supplies versioned, evidence-bound topology context for Workroom incident investigation and blast-radius estimation. GAIA is the topology authority — Prophet Platform validates snapshot references only.

gaia_graph_ref.description: Reference to the GAIA graph from which this snapshot was produced.

snapshot_digest.description: Content-addressable digest of the snapshot payload.

scope.description: Human-readable description of the topology scope (workspace, environment, service boundary).

service_refs.description: Service node refs included in this snapshot.

dependency_refs.description: Dependency node refs (databases, queues, external services) included in this snapshot.
